title: 한국농공학회논문집 2024년 제66권 5호
headline: 이번 호의 핵심 흐름은 ‘온실 · 바이오매스 · 환기’(2편)입니다. 가장 많이 등장한 키워드는 ‘water balance analysis · 물수지 분석’이며, 농촌진흥청 연구진이 3편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 새로 등장한 키워드: ‘Light detection and ranging (LiDAR)’, ‘structural analysis · 구조해석’, ‘structural safety diagnostic’, ‘unsupervised algorithm’, ‘fertilization practice’.
주로 쓰인 방법론: LiDAR, APEX, LSTM/RNN, 기계학습(일반).

papers.title: 비닐 온실의 현장 안전진단을 위한 3차원 LiDAR 스캔 기법 기반 구조 형상 추정
papers.title_en: Structural Shape Estimation Based on 3D LiDAR Scanning Method for On-site Safety Diagnostic of Plastic Greenhouse

summary.result: At a maximum snow depth of 0.5 m, the scan model revealed asymmetric horizontal deflection and extreme bending stress, which indicated that even minor shape irregularities could result in critical failures in extreme weather.
summary.background: In this study, we applied an on-site diagnostic method for estimating the structural safety of a plastic greenhouse.
summary.method: The error of the scan model was accurate at 2%-3%, whereas the error of the blueprint model was 5.4%.

papers.title: APEX 모델을 이용한 옥수수-가을배추 재배지의 시비 수준별 비점오염 부하량 평가
papers.title_en: Evaluation of Non-Point Pollution Loads in Corn-Autumn Kimchi Cabbage Cultivation Areas by Fertilizer Application Levels Using the APEX Model

summary.result: The simulation results under conventional fertilization practices revealed significantly higher NPP loads compared to the standard fertilization, with P loads under conventional practices being notably higher.
summary.background: Agriculture is recognized as an important anthropogenic cause of non-point source loads.
summary.method: The model calibration and validation showed satisfactory performance in simulating nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) loads, illustrating the model's applicability in a Korean agricultural setting.

papers.title: 물수지 기반 농업용 저수지 내한능력 및 이수안전도 평가
papers.title_en: Evaluation of Water Supply Reliability in Agricultural Reservoirs Using Water Balance Analysis

summary.result: As a result, Yongmyeon Reservoir was found to be stable in terms of water supply reliability, whereas Seongho and Yongpung Reservoirs were found to be unstable using all methods.
summary.background: The design frequency of drought, the number of years areservoir needs to be able to withstand a drought phenomenon, foragricultural water resources in Korea is the 10-year drought.
summary.method: The previously designed frequency and water balance analysis were used to calculate and analyze reservoir storage capacity, water supply turnover, water supply amount, water supply potential, water utilization safety, and water supply reliability.

papers.title: 저수지 제체 월류수위 예측을 위한 Fuzzy Time Series법의 적용성 비교 평가
papers.title_en: Comparative Evaluation on Applicability of Fuzzy Time Series Method for Predicting Overtopping of Reservoir Embankment

summary.result: As a result, the reservoir water level was applied to predict the overtopping water level, and it was shown that the FTS method could predict the actual water levels effectively according to the result of comparison with LSTM.
summary.background: An increasing pattern of extreme rainfall recently affected the rural infrastructures with catastrophic damage, especially the overtopping of a fill dam embankment in the Republic of Korea.
summary.method: Fuzzy time series (FTS) is a fuzzy-logic inference procedure and is suited to apply to non-linear prediction methods such as machine learning.

papers.title: 드론 방제 살포 효율 개선을 위한 하향풍 및 액적 퇴적 분포 분석
papers.title_en: Analysis of Drone Downwash and Droplet Deposition for Improved Aerial Spraying Efficiency in Agriculture

summary.result: At an effective spray width of 3R, the coefficient of variation (CV) was generally less than 16%, indicating a significant improvement in spray uniformity.
summary.background: With the advancement of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) technology, aerial spraying has been rapidly increasing in the agricultural field.
summary.method: Experiments were conducted using two agricultural drones with different propeller arrangements under various flight and measurement conditions.

papers.title: 이설쌓기 둑높임 저수지의 연계 물수지 분석을 위한 DIROM 모형의 적용성 평가
papers.title_en: Application of DIROM Model for Water Balance Analysis of Consecutively Linked Reservoir System

summary.result: By supplementing the missing water use data, the NSE (Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency) of the Sonhang reservoir storage rate simulation improved by approximately 30%.
summary.background: Water balance analysis in heightened reservoirs, which have been raised to ensure a stable supply of irrigation water and secure water against floods and heavy rainfall, is essential for evaluating water supply capacity and reservoir maintenance.
summary.method: Methods to supplement missing data and improve the limitations of simulated inflow were proposed and applied, and the performance of the daily storage simulation was evaluated.
